Tap two Plains and a Thriving Heath for {2}{W}, cast Cathar’s Companion targeting Emiel the Blessed.

Then, if the ability triggers, I’ll pay {G/W} to give Emiel a +1/+1 counter, making it 6/6 with vigilance. That’s a huge, resilient threat.

Cast now.

No actions possible.

Pass priority to end turn.

Cathar’s Companion is 4/2 with lifelink — if it deals combat damage to player, I gain 4 life.

Mesa Unicorn is 3/3 lifelink.

If Eidolon blocks one, the other should be unblocked.

But battlefield shows both are blocked.

This is likely a display error.

In reality, Eidolon can only block one.

Assume it blocks Cathar’s Companion.

Then Mesa Unicorn is unblocked — 3 damage.

Cathar’s Companion fights 1/4 — deals 4, takes 1 — Eidolon dies.

So total damage: 3 (Mesa) + 4 (Cathar) = 7.

They go to 1.

I gain 7 life.

Or if they block Mesa, same outcome.

Either way, they're at 1 life.

Pass priority — no spells to cast.

Let damage resolve.

annotations.description: Single-blocking Cathar's Companion 4/2 with a 1/4 Eidolon of Rhetoric results in the Eidolon dying. By double-blocking the 4/2 with both Amoeboid Changeling and the sick Eidolon, the opponent would be forced to assign at least 1 damage to each blocker, meaning the Eidolon (4 toughness) would survive taking only 3 damage. This preserves both Eidolons, which is especially valuable since Eidolon of Rhetoric restricts the opponent to one spell per turn when they have 4 cards in hand.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked Cathar's Companion with one Eidolon (which dies) and Mesa Unicorn with the other Eidolon (which survives), leaving Amoeboid Changeling unassigned.
